name: A Donation of Wool
summary: The High Order is accepting donations of wool cloth. You can earn its full recognition by giving sixty pieces.

sections.title: A Worthy Gift
sections.body: The High Order is taking donations of wool cloth, and sixty pieces are enough for its current needs. The giver can accept them from you now; your donation earns full recognition from the order.

faq.q: What does the High Order need?
faq.answer: The High Order is accepting wool cloth donations, and sixty pieces are sufficient for its current needs.

faq.q: How much wool cloth should I give?
faq.answer: A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth earns full recognition from the High Order.
The giver of this request can accept your sixty pieces of wool cloth.

faq.q: What do I gain by donating?
faq.answer: Giving sixty pieces of wool cloth earns you full recognition from the High Order.
